critique.evidence: The screen has a cohesive, polished dark-grid visual system, strong cyan/red/yellow semantic accents, clear headline-to-card hierarchy, and a well-resolved responsive card on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Typography and spacing remain readable at all three sizes. However, the tablet header navigation is visibly clipped beneath the fixed red-mode control, while the mobile viewport drops the entire brand/navigation header, creating an inconsistent frame across viewports. Tablet/mobile headline edges also show distracting red/cyan fringing, and the desktop composition leaves the explanatory artifact block visually detached in a large empty area.
critique.fix: Make the global header deliberately responsive: collapse navigation into a compact menu on tablet and retain a small branded header on mobile instead of clipping or removing it. Eliminate unintended chromatic fringing on large type, and tighten the desktop hero by aligning the results-artifact explanation more clearly with the intro copy or card grid.
